mode: ask
description: "Generate or update a screenshot gallery page section with consistent naming, captions, and responsive layout guidance."
Create or refine a screenshots gallery section for the WeFitNest marketing website.

Inputs:

List of screenshot files available
Preferred grouping categories
Whether lightbox is enabled
Output requirements:

Category structure and ordering
Human-friendly captions for each screenshot
Suggested alt text for accessibility
Responsive layout guidance:
mobile behavior
tablet behavior
desktop behavior
Performance guidance:
image sizing
modern formats
lazy loading strategy
Missing asset checklist if any feature is underrepresented
Constraints:

Keep naming and captions consistent with tutorial sections
Do not invent app behavior not represented by real screenshots
